homs.name: HOMS Assessment Desk
homs.campaign_line: Assessment work, prepared for educator review.
audiences: South African teachers with a marking backlog
Lecturers and tutors handling electronic assessment batches
Schools and departments that need CAPS-aware papers and memoranda
Tutors, extra-class providers, and publishers building connected learning material

offers.name: HOMS Marking Relief
offers.promise: Send the learner work, rubric or memo, and marksheet. Receive structured draft marks, feedback, and an educator review pack.

offers.name: HOMS Exam Studio
offers.promise: Send the subject, grade, term, scope, and assessment requirements. Receive a draft paper, memorandum, and source or visual pack where the subject requires it.

offers.name: HOMS One-Topic Companion
offers.promise: Define one subject, grade, term, and topic. Receive a connected guide, activity, worksheet, assessment, and memo for subject-expert review.

offers.name: HOMS Video Lesson Pack
offers.promise: Add a faceless, captioned explainer lesson to the same curriculum spine, with its worksheet and assessment kept in alignment.

proof: A controlled three-script marking batch produced marks, feedback, a marked gradebook, and a lecturer review summary.
Exam Studio proof runs produced paired papers and memoranda with CAPS-, grade-, term-, and subject-aware constraints.
The Grade 10 Physical Sciences Motion proof connects a guide, practical, worksheet, mini-assessment, memoranda, meaningful diagrams and a captioned video lesson through one curriculum spine.
Every output remains subject to educator or subject-expert approval before use.
claim_boundaries: Do not claim that HOMS replaces an educator or subject expert.
Do not promise automatic correctness, final marks, or classroom-ready use without review.
Describe generated marks, feedback, papers, sources, and memoranda as drafts or review-ready outputs.
Describe the learning companion as a golden review candidate until its curriculum and answers pass subject-expert approval; media rights and attribution are already receipted.

gamma_assets.title: HOMS Assessment Desk hero
gamma_assets.purpose: website hero and campaign key art
gamma_assets.prompt: Create a single photorealistic 16:9 commercial key-art image for a South African educator assessment service. Show an educator at a clean desk reviewing a coherent set of real-looking work artifacts: learner scripts with handwritten answers, a rubric, a marksheet grid, and a professionally formatted exam paper with a memorandum. The documents must look materially real, detailed and connected to one workflow, but contain no readable names or private learner information. Use natural daylight, restrained charcoal, paper white, muted teal and one warm amber accent. The educator remains visibly in control. Full-bleed editorial photography, practical and trustworthy. No text, no logos, no presentation slide, no infographic, no floating cards, no dashboard, no collage, no PowerPoint template.

gamma_assets.title: HOMS Marking Relief proof
gamma_assets.prompt: Create one realistic overhead 16:9 documentary photograph of an assessment marking workflow. On the left: a small batch of anonymised learner scripts and a concise rubric. In the centre: an educator's hand checking nuanced feedback. On the right: a clean marked gradebook and lecturer review summary. Make the before-to-review progression obvious through physical arrangement, not arrows or labels. Papers must have plausible lines, ticks and tables but no readable personal data. Crisp editorial lighting, white paper, graphite, restrained teal and amber details. No visible headline, no logos, no boxes, no infographic, no slide design, no artificial UI panels.

gamma_assets.title: HOMS Exam Studio proof
gamma_assets.prompt: Create a single high-end 16:9 editorial photograph showing a CAPS-aware assessment production desk. Include a South African curriculum document with non-readable text, a grade-and-term planning sheet, a polished exam paper, a matching memorandum, and one subject-appropriate source extract or scientific diagram. The outputs should visibly belong together and look professionally typeset. A subject expert is reviewing the final paper with a pen. Use clear neutral light, charcoal, white, muted blue-green and amber. No readable brands, no learner data, no headline, no logos, no presentation, no infographic, no floating cards, no generic template layout.

gamma_assets.title: HOMS One-Topic Companion
gamma_assets.prompt: Create one photorealistic 16:9 editorial scene of a coherent South African Grade 9 Natural Sciences topic companion pack about electrical circuits. Show a concise concept guide, a clearly labelled circuit diagram, a hands-on activity sheet, a worksheet, a short assessment and its memorandum arranged as one visibly connected sequence. A teacher is checking alignment between the diagram, questions and answer key. Documents should look detailed and usable but contain no learner names. Natural classroom worktable, white paper, graphite, restrained teal and yellow accents. No headline, no logos, no slide deck, no floating cards, no generic template, no disconnected stock images.

gamma_assets.title: HOMS Video Lesson Pack
gamma_assets.purpose: faceless extra-class video lesson campaign creative
gamma_assets.prompt: Create one realistic 16:9 production scene for a faceless curriculum video lesson. Show a laptop previewing a clear electrical-circuit explanation with a real labelled diagram, beside a matching storyboard, narration script, worksheet and short assessment. A compact audio timeline and headphones indicate a voiced, captioned lesson, while the paper materials visibly test the same topic. No presenter face is required. Use a practical educator workspace, crisp neutral light, charcoal, white, green and yellow details. No readable brand, no headline, no presentation slide, no floating UI cards, no fake dashboard, no generic PowerPoint composition.

evidex.name: Evidex Evidence Pack
evidex.campaign_line: From scattered proof to a traceable review pack.
audiences: NGOs and community organisations preparing donor or programme evidence
Monitoring and evaluation practitioners consolidating proof
Grant consultants and small compliance teams preparing review files

offers.name: Starter Evidence Pack
offers.promise: A small, bounded evidence set organised into a table with mapped claims and provenance for human review.

offers.name: Standard Evidence Pack
offers.promise: A broader reporting pack with evidence mapping, provenance, gaps, and a clear review trail.

offers.name: Complex Evidence Pack
offers.promise: A larger multi-source pack scoped after intake, with human review before delivery.

proof: The golden case converts attendance, field notes, KPI data, a photo log, and receipts into an evidence table and mapped claims.
Each mapped claim retains a source reference and provenance trail.
The pack supports review; it does not guarantee donor, auditor, regulator, or funder approval.
claim_boundaries: Do not claim Evidex guarantees approval, compliance, audit outcomes, or funding.
Do not describe unreviewed outputs as final or submission-ready.
Use review-ready only when human review is explicitly stated.

vamp.name: VAMP Performance Evidence Desk
vamp.campaign_line: Evidence prepared for the review, with the human decision kept human.
audiences: HR administrators and performance coordinators consolidating proof
Department heads who need an inspectable objective-to-evidence trail

offers.name: Performance Evidence Snapshot
offers.promise: Send an authorised task agreement and bounded evidence set. Receive objective mapping, candidates, gaps, provenance and a review snapshot.

proof: A controlled private proof processed 190 evidence records and retained 116 accepted mappings plus 24 review candidates.
The proof reported 63.9% evidence-backed objective coverage and exposed gaps instead of inventing support.
VAMP prepares evidence; an authorised human owns interpretation, ratings and release.
claim_boundaries: Do not claim that VAMP makes performance ratings, promotion decisions or employment decisions.
Do not publish raw employment evidence or identifiable client records as campaign proof.
Require consent, an organisation-specific objective profile and authorised human approval before delivery.
